newsitem.title: SPAIN: Two bids for Spain Retevision, Mannesmann drop out.
newsitem.headline: Two bids for Spain Retevision, Mannesmann drop out.

text.p: Two of the three consortia interested in the privatisation of 60 percent of Spain's second telephone operator Retevision presented final offers on Monday, as Germany's Mannesmann dropped out, Retevision said.

"The Opera group (BCH, France Telecom, and Sprint ) and the group formed by Endesa and Stet have deposited the collection of boxes," Retevision director Jose Manuel Garcia said, adding that Mannesmann had not presented an offer.

Both of the bidders arrived at Retevision's headquarters in Madrid laden with boxes of documentation outlining plans to transform Retevision into a competitor to former state operator Telefonica de Espana, while the Mannesmann representative submitted a small envelope.
On Tuesday, Retevision plans to announce the size of the money offers of the two bids, a key factor according to analysts, but not the only one in the privatisation of the state broadcaster.
Spain's Development Minister Rafael Arias-Salgado has said the government would announce the winner in two weeks.
